methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: AI Ready Roanoke evaluates use for new technology in Roanoke Valley - Roanoke Times
signals.signal_reading: A community-driven AI readiness initiative in Roanoke Valley signals grassroots capacity-building beyond traditional tech hubs, suggesting distributed learning networks could activate outside NoVA if sustained with resources and peer knowledge transfer.

signals.title: News Flash Archive - NPD E911 Division implements Artificial Intelligence (AI) system on non-emergency lines - City of Norfolk (.gov)
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk's deployment of turnkey AI for non-emergency 911 calls represents shallow-but-functional adoption through vendor platforms—distributed geographically but not building deep local AI capability or workforce skills.

signals.title: Amazon bows to local backlash over AI data centers, scraps plans to build four new facilities in Northern Virginia — site to be repurposed for mixed-use and residential development. - Tom's Hardware
signals.signal_reading: Amazon's scrapped data center plans reveal infrastructure concentration without community benefit or workforce development, exposing how AI's physical footprint can deepen regional inequality when local backlash prevents even shallow distribution mechanisms.

signals.title: Virginia governor orders statewide plan to address AI cyberattacks - StateScoop
signals.signal_reading: Statewide cybersecurity planning for AI threats signals state-level coordination capacity but likely concentrates implementation expertise in Richmond and NoVA government tech centers rather than distributing defensive AI literacy across all regions.

signals.title: Norfolk police officer uses AI to build music career and TikTok following - The Virginian-Pilot
signals.signal_reading: A Norfolk officer independently mastering generative AI for creative work exemplifies peer-driven skill acquisition outside formal tech sectors—individual deep learning that could seed broader cultural shifts if supported by institutional knowledge-sharing infrastructure.
